annotations.exact_quote: Consensus clustering (also known as aggregation of clustering) can improve clustering robustness, deal with distributed and heterogeneous data sources and make use of multiple clustering criteria.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确以consensus clustering/aggregation of clustering为研究任务，旨在融合多个聚类结果实现共识划分，符合集成聚类定义。

annotations.exact_quote: formulated within the framework of nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF)
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要说明将consensus与semi-supervised clustering放在NMF框架下构建算法，NMF是论文实质采用的方法。

annotations.exact_quote: Semi-supervised clustering can integrate various forms of background knowledge into clustering.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文研究半监督聚类，将背景知识作为监督信息整合进聚类，属于结合有限监督与未标注样本的半监督学习设定。

abstentions.reason_zh: 摘要仅称consensus clustering可处理distributed and heterogeneous data sources，未说明多客户端保留本地原始数据并以模型更新协作训练，证据不足。
摘要仅提semi-supervised clustering整合various forms of background knowledge，未明确监督信号不完整、不精确、粗粒度或不准确，无法判定为弱监督学习。
摘要仅笼统提background knowledge，未说明must-link/cannot-link或其传播扩展，机制证据不足。
